events.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Barcelona 1, Feyenoord 0. Raphinha (Barcelona) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Lamine Yamal.
Goal! Barcelona 2, Feyenoord 0. Karim Adeyemi (Barcelona) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by João Cancelo.
Charles Vanhoutte (Feyenoord) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Barcelona 2, Feyenoord 0.
Substitution, Feyenoord. Oussama Targhalline replaces Javi López.
Dani Olmo (Barcelona) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Barcelona 3, Feyenoord 0. Raphinha (Barcelona) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Pedri with a through ball.
Substitution, Feyenoord. Shaqueel van Persie replaces Nacho Ferri.
Substitution, Barcelona. Marc Bernal replaces Pedri.
Substitution, Barcelona. Anthony Gordon replaces Karim Adeyemi.
Substitution, Barcelona. Fermín López replaces Raphinha.
Substitution, Feyenoord. Gonçalo Borges replaces Anis Hadj Moussa.
Substitution, Feyenoord. Sem Steijn replaces Charles Vanhoutte.
Goal! Barcelona 4, Feyenoord 0. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) from a free kick with a left footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Goal! Barcelona 4, Feyenoord 1. Sem Steijn (Feyenoord) right footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Gonçalo Borges with a cross.
Substitution, Barcelona. Gabriel Jesus replaces Dani Olmo.
Substitution, Barcelona. Gavi replaces Rodri.
Substitution, Feyenoord. Tobias van den Elshout replaces Luciano Valente.
Goal! Barcelona 5, Feyenoord 1. Gabriel Jesus (Barcelona) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Lamine Yamal with a cross.
Second Half ends, Barcelona 5, Feyenoord 1.
